issues.where: the cave floor edge across the mouth and where the right cave wall meets the floor (also set-B-06.png right crop)
issues.what: the cave floor is a completely flat plane that ends in a ruler-straight horizontal line against the distant mountain and sky, and meets the right wall along a sharp geometric seam with an abrupt polygonal corner and no snow drift, rubble, or contact occlusion
issues.fix: break up the ledge edge with uneven ice and snow geometry, add drifted snow, rock debris, and contact occlusion along the wall-to-floor seam, and remove the hard straight plane cutoff

issues.where: the cave interior walls across all four crops
issues.what: the rock and snow texture is heavily stretched and smeared along a smooth tubular cave surface, reading as blurry low-resolution streaks up close rather than fractured rock and crisp frost
issues.fix: rebuild the cave walls with real rock displacement, varied materials, and undistorted triplanar or higher-resolution mapping so detail holds up close to the camera

issues.where: the lightning bolt and impact point at the top of the central spire
issues.what: the strike terminates in a neat white circle with straight, spiky starburst sparks, has minimal optical bloom, and casts no bright light onto the spire rock, snow, or streamers immediately beside it
issues.fix: add realistic optical bloom and irregular plasma glow to the bolt and impact, and illuminate the surrounding spire face, clouds, and streamers with strong flash bounce light

issues.where: the lightning bolt outside the cave mouth
issues.what: the bolt reads as a stark, thin white jagged line with no bloom or atmospheric scatter, lighting neither the dark clouds around it nor the mountain and cave mouth
issues.fix: give the lightning physical bloom and scatter into the surrounding clouds, and cast corresponding flash illumination onto the distant peak, icicles, and cave rim

issues.where: the four creatures on the cave floor
issues.what: the standing creature and the huddled group lack believable contact shadows and snow displacement on the ice, making them appear pasted onto the floor, and show no frost, wet snow, or ice crust from the environment
issues.fix: ground their feet and bodies with deeper contact shadows and subtle depressions in the snow, and add frost, clumped snow, and rim-lit moisture to their lower fur

issues.where: the creature head, forelegs, and fur in the left crop
issues.what: at native size the fur reads as clumpy, matted flat cards, the protruding forelegs look like smooth clay cylinders, and the shiny dark head and tentacles meet the fur along an abrupt synthetic seam
issues.fix: increase strand-level fur density and breakup to remove card clumps, add textured hide and snow buildup to the limbs, and blend the head-to-fur transition naturally

issues.where: the translucent streamers and tether lines in the top-right crop
issues.what: the streamers look like glossy plastic-wrap ribbon meshes with hard specular edges and aliased dark tether lines, while the distant streamers on the right spires in set-B-01.png read as flat soft smoke cards
issues.fix: break up the ribbon edges with realistic subsurface scattering, organic micro-detail, and anti-aliased tethers, and give the distant streamers consistent volumetric depth

issues.where: the hanging icicles in the top-right crop
issues.what: the icicles appear as uniform, semi-opaque blue-grey cones with flat shading and abrupt intersections into the blurred cave arch
issues.fix: give the icicles irregular melted shapes, clear glass-like refraction and specular highlights, and blend their bases into an icy crust along the rock ceiling

issues.where: the overhanging spire tip and hanging pod cluster in the top-left crop
issues.what: the rock tip has a smooth clay-like silhouette with stretched dark texture, and the reddish-brown pods read as smooth, uniformly shaded models with no frost, snow, or surface integration
issues.fix: add crisp rock micro-displacement and snow buildup along the overhang, and weather the pods with frost, roughness variation, and tighter contact shadows

issues.where: the storm clouds and lower mist layer behind the foreground peaks (also set-B-02.png bottom-left and set-B-03.png right)
issues.what: the storm clouds are blurry and painterly at native size, and the pale mist behind the central spire base has sharp, ragged cutout edges that read like flat cards
issues.fix: replace the soft sky backdrop with higher-resolution volumetric cloud detail and turn the valley mist into layered, light-catching atmospheric volume

issues.where: the icy cave floor and the distant mountain outside the mouth
issues.what: the ice floor shows a generic warm reflection streak while failing to reflect the cave walls, creatures, or lightning, and the distant mountain has harsh dark-and-white contrast with too little intervening air
issues.fix: add accurate reflections and surface variation to the ice floor, and increase atmospheric haze on the distant peak

issues.where: the vertical rock flanks of the central spire in the left crop
issues.what: the steep rock and snow surface shows mild vertical texture stretching and repeats one uniform procedural rock-and-snow material across all spires
issues.fix: add varied rock strata, wind-scoured ice patches, and triplanar detail variation across the spires
